notes.title: Final Update 2022/8/3
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing 愛莉澄.
We are pleased to announce that we have made several final fix updates.
The fixes are as follows.

・Addition of a button to exit the game
・Other minor fixes

notes.title: Update 2022.4.15
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing 愛莉澄.

Please check that we have made some corrections to the game content.
The correction points are as follows.

・Fixed a bug that door opening and closing does not respond
・Fixed the menu screen in the game so that it can be operated with the mouse cursor.
